ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and flag the driver's account for abuse of the "I'm Here" / cancellation-fee button.
ruling.reasoning: NS-0 routes this to NS-1/NS-2: the driver cancelled and claims the rider was a no-show. NS-1's three conditions all fail. (i) The "I'm Here" tap happened — F5 shows a driver tap at 12:06:15 — but (ii) at that moment the driver was 600 m from the pickup point [F5], far outside the 200 m arrival radius; the driver's closest approach over the whole trip was 599 m [F1] and the platform never recorded an arrival [F4]. (iii) After the tap the driver stayed within 200 m for 0 s [F5]: he was stationary 12:05:55–12:09:25, 600 m away [F2], which is neither "at the pickup point" nor within range for the required continuous >3 min. Rider messages [F8][F9][F10] corroborate that the car was never at the pickup. Under NS-2 the $6.61 charged [F6] must be refunded in full. Because the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS placed him >200 m from the pickup point [F5][F1], the additional NS-2 flag applies; the driver's profile does not decide this case (only supporting the account referral), and no routing/consent clause is triggered since there was no completed trip.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement [F12] that he pressed I'm Here and waited >3 min at the pickup is contradicted by system records: GPS shows 600 m from pickup at the tap [F5], closest approach 599 m [F1], no platform-recorded arrival [F4], and 0 s within 200 m after the tap [F5]. System records override statements.
